content.short: Charli3 is a decentralized oracle network bringing verified off-chain data feeds to Cardano smart contracts.
content.description: Charli3 is a decentralized oracle network built for Cardano applications that need trusted off-chain data on-chain. It provides market, pricing, and external data feeds that smart contracts can read when executing DeFi logic or other data-dependent workflows. The network uses node operators to source, validate, and publish information, giving Cardano builders a native oracle layer instead of relying only on centralized APIs. Charli3 supports projects that need accurate, timely data for lending, trading, analytics, and automation.
